items.quote: And he took and put the testimony into the ark
items.claim: He put the testimony into the ark.
items.actor: he (probably Moses, going by the closing clause; the verses never name him)
items.mechanism: done as the LORD commanded Moses (40:21)

items.quote: and set the staves on the ark
items.claim: He put the carrying poles (staves) on the ark.
items.actor: he (probably Moses; not named in these verses)
items.mechanism: done as the LORD commanded Moses (40:21)

items.quote: and put the mercy seat above upon the ark
items.claim: He put the mercy seat on top of the ark.
items.actor: he (probably Moses; not named in these verses)
items.mechanism: done as the LORD commanded Moses (40:21)

items.quote: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle
items.claim: He brought the ark into the tabernacle.
items.actor: he (probably Moses; not named in these verses)
items.mechanism: done as the LORD commanded Moses (40:21)

items.quote: and set up the vail of the covering
items.claim: He set up the covering veil.
items.actor: he (probably Moses; not named in these verses)
items.mechanism: done as the LORD commanded Moses (40:21)

items.quote: and covered the ark of the testimony
items.claim: He covered the ark of the testimony, apparently with the veil set up just before.
items.actor: he (probably Moses; not named in these verses)
items.mechanism: done as the LORD commanded Moses (40:21)

items.claim: The text says these acts followed the LORD's command to Moses. This is the text's own framing, not something checked independently.
items.mechanism: divine command, as the text reports it
